title: R49 SKN serving-mask evaluation against production
summary: On 129 paired SKN scenes evaluated with the serving land mask, R49 achieved IoU 0.3903 versus 0.2148 for the production R46+R47 mean-probability ensemble. The paired difference was +0.1755 with a 95% interval of [0.0928, 0.2500].
scope: Model 1 comparison of R49 with the production R46+R47 mean-probability ensemble on the SKN evaluation cohort under the serving land mask.

limitations: The R49 validation split was used for model selection.
The historical guarded-label IoU of 0.6440 comes from a different cohort and metric and was test-tuned. It is not comparable to this SKN result and is not an unbiased serving estimate.
This evaluation does not change the selected production model or its serving scope.
